# Butler v0.0.24

## Change Log

- Includes bounded, phase-aware Work context projection, reliable tool
  execution, and preservation of mixed App-owned state during storage migration,
  together with the workspace, provider, memory, and product consolidation
  improvements shipped in v0.0.23.
- Restores the Windows community installer path without external certificate
  secrets. GitHub Releases publish the manually updated installer and checksum;
  trusted distribution remains owned by Microsoft Store.
- Repairs `butler doctor` on macOS after retired hook integrations are absent,
  so an empty hook inventory reports a passing diagnostic instead of exiting.

This release supersedes v0.0.21 through v0.0.23 for desktop and Agent
installations.
